birthdays.name: Birthdays
birthdays.description: A Birthdays page (quick-add a person with day + month, year optional) plus a birthday on each contact: age when the year is known, the next birthday (repeats every year), a badge on the contact, and an 'Upcoming birthdays' widget on the home screen. People added here are contacts too.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.description: The family calendar: trips, conferences, appointments and holidays, with people and to-dos, next to task due dates, birthdays, car due dates and project starts. Month and timeline views, a subscribe link for Google/Apple Calendar.

contacts.name: Contacts
contacts.description: A shared family address book. Each entry is a 'person' — a reusable primitive (name + contact methods) that other modules extend: Birthdays adds a birthdate, and projects can link people.

expense_import.name: Expense import
expense_import.description: Bring card spending into Spending: upload a bank statement (Wise, Revolut, ING, BT, or any CSV/XLSX after mapping its columns once) or send each Apple Pay payment from an iPhone Shortcut. Every row is reviewed before it's saved, duplicates are flagged, each import can be undone, and imported transactions are remembered so they never come in twice.
expense_import.tagline: Bank statements and Apple Pay into Spending

important_todos.name: Important Todos
important_todos.description: Adds an "important" flag to tasks: a toggle in the task editor, a star on the row, and important tasks sorted first. A worked example of extending a primitive through hooks.
important_todos.tagline: Star tasks to keep them on top

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.description: Know what you have, what's running low, and what needs replenishing — calm household stock, not a warehouse.
inventory.tagline: What you have and what's low

notes.name: Notes
notes.description: Quick family notes and checklists, kept tidy in folders.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: In-app and push alerts so nobody misses family activity.

projects.name: Projects
projects.description: Plan the bigger things: tasks, progress, and linked shopping lists.
projects.tagline: Gather lists and notes for a goal

recipes.name: Recipes
recipes.description: Family recipes with photos and a calculator: scale by servings, by how much you want to make, or by what you have.

recurring_todos.name: Recurring To-dos
recurring_todos.description: Make a to-do repeat on a schedule: pick a date and an interval, and once it's completed it resets to 'to do' again on its next occurrence.
recurring_todos.tagline: Tasks that come back on schedule

shopping.name: Shopping
shopping.description: Shared grocery and shopping lists the whole family can check off together.

spending.name: Spending
spending.description: Track shared costs and settle up who owes who, split any way you like.

tasks.name: Tasks
tasks.description: Shared to-do lists with due dates, sub-tasks, and who's assigned.
tasks.tagline: To-do lists with people and dates

vehicles.name: Vehicles
vehicles.description: The home for everything about the family cars — state, mileage, maintenance, expenses and documents. Calm car care, not a workshop system.
